INSERT INTO ingestion_batches (
    source_file,
    file_hash,
    status
)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'processing')
ON CONFLICT (file_hash)
    WHERE status IN ('processing', 'completed')
DO NOTHING
RETURNING
    batch_id::text AS batch_id,
    source_file,
    file_hash,
    status,
    started_at;

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO sales_transactions (
        batch_id,
        source_row_number,
        invoice_no,
        stock_code,
        description,
        quantity,
        invoice_date,
        unit_price,
        customer_id,
        country
    )
    SELECT
        r.batch_id,
        r.source_row_number,
        r.invoice_no,
        r.stock_code,
        r.description,
        r.quantity,
        r.invoice_date,
        r.unit_price,
        r.customer_id,
        r.country
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r (
        batch_id UUID,
        source_row_number INTEGER,
        invoice_no VARCHAR(20),
        stock_code VARCHAR(50),
        description TEXT,
        quantity INTEGER,
        invoice_date TIMESTAMP,
        unit_price NUMERIC(12, 4),
        customer_id VARCHAR(30),
        country VARCHAR(100)
    )
    ON CONFLICT (batch_id, source_row_number)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS inserted_records
FROM inserted;

WITH inserted AS (
    INSERT INTO rejected_records (
        batch_id,
        source_row_number,
        raw_record,
        rejection_reason
    )
    SELECT
        r.batch_id,
        r.source_row_number,
        r.raw_record,
        r.rejection_reason
    FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS r (
        batch_id UUID,
        source_row_number INTEGER,
        raw_record JSONB,
        rejection_reason TEXT
    )
    ON CONFLICT (batch_id, source_row_number)
    DO NOTHING
    RETURNING 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*)::INTEGER AS inserted_records
FROM inserted;

WITH record_counts AS (
    SELECT
        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM sales_transactions
            WHERE batch_id = $1::UUID
        ) AS valid_count,

        (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM rejected_records
            WHERE batch_id = $1::UUID
        ) AS rejected_count
)
UPDATE ingestion_batches AS b
SET
    total_records = rc.valid_count + rc.rejected_count,
    valid_records = rc.valid_count,
    rejected_records = rc.rejected_count,
    status = 'completed',
    completed_at = NOW(),
    error_message = NULL
FROM record_counts AS rc
WHERE b.batch_id = $1::UUID
  AND b.status = 'processing'
RETURNING
    b.batch_id,
    b.source_file,
    b.status,
    b.total_records,
    b.valid_records,
    b.rejected_records,
    b.started_at,
    b.completed_at;
